items.exampleEn: Which branch do you work at?
Where is the entrance to the station?
My uncle lives abroad, so I only see him once a year.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在國外，所以我一年只見到他一次。

items.exampleEn: My sister studies architecture at university.
There are seven continents in the world.
The royal family lives in a big palace.
items.exampleZh: 王室一家人住在一座大宮殿裡。

items.exampleEn: The story is about a small kingdom by the sea.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事在講海邊的一個小王國。

items.exampleEn: We used a globe to find Japan.
items.exampleZh: 我們用地球儀找日本在哪裡。

items.sentenceEn: Please wait for me at the entrance.

items.audioEn: Our company has a new branch in Taichung.
items.audioZh: 我們公司在台中有一間新的分公司。
items.questionZh: 公司在哪裡開了新的分公司？

items.sentenceEn: This shop has five branches in Taipei.
items.sentenceZh: 這家店在台北有五間分店。

items.stemEn: Africa is a big ____ with many countries.
items.stemZh: 非洲是一個有很多國家的大洲。

items.stemEn: Please use the side ____. The front door is closed.
items.stemZh: 請走側門入口，前門關起來了。

items.passageEn: Last spring, Mia traveled abroad for the first time. She visited a small kingdom in Europe. She loved the old architecture, especially the castle of the royal family. At the castle entrance, there was a big globe. "I want to visit every continent someday," Mia said.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，Mia 第一次出國旅行。她去了歐洲的一個小王國。她很喜歡那裡古老的建築，尤其是王室的城堡。城堡入口有一個很大的地球儀。Mia 說：「總有一天我要去每一個洲看看。」

options: 古老的建築，尤其是王室的城堡

items.promptZh: 我哥哥明年要出國工作。
referenceEn: My brother will work abroad next year.
My older brother is going to work abroad next year.
rubricZh: 「出國」用 abroad，前面不加 to（例如 work abroad、go abroad）
未來的事可寫例如 will、be going to

items.instructionZh: 用 entrance 造一個句子，告訴別人在哪個入口見面，或入口在哪裡。
referenceEn: You can find the entrance behind the building.
Let's meet at the north entrance of the park.
rubricZh: entrance 是名詞「入口」（例如 the entrance to the park、the north entrance）
「在入口」可用 at（例如 at the north entrance）
